dedupe_keys.name: ble rssi dataset for freight wagon passage detection at railway station control points

description: The dataset author publishes Bluetooth low-energy signal-strength measurements for detecting freight-wagon passage direction at station control points. Zenodo provides an archive of Excel tables under CC BY 4.0. The description identifies eight categories covering forward or backward passage, before- or after-edge detection, left or right path, and runs at forty or fifty kilometres per hour. Each table lists receipt time, gateway and device identifiers, RSSI, transmit power, battery state and temperature; gateways were fifteen metres apart. These signals can calibrate freight-train passage detection or operational monitoring simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the measurements. Coverage is the stated control-point setup, not an entire national rail network. A limitation is that radio propagation and detection performance may differ with station geometry and rolling stock; the summary does not give sample counts. No workbook was downloaded or direction classifier tested.
